name: YFlix Local
description: YFlix Local v0.5.0. S2 now exposes only live VidBolt streams after HLS/Range probing and hides broken cards. S4 replaces mismatched Singularity with FilmU Videasy and verifies media identity by TMDB/IMDb/title/year plus HLS runtime.

scrapers.name: YFlix · Server 1
scrapers.description: YFlix Server 1 (Multi Source): direct PlayAPI stream API using TMDB IDs. DahmerMovies is filtered after device playback failures.
scrapers.author: YFlix Local

scrapers.name: YFlix · Server 2
scrapers.description: YFlix Server 2 (Multi Dubbed): current VidBolt Quasar resolver with per-stream live probing. Expired HLS and dead file proxies are hidden instead of shown as playable cards.
scrapers.author: YFlix Local

scrapers.name: YFlix · Server 4
scrapers.description: YFlix Server 4 (Multi Audio): FilmU Videasy HLS using TMDB+IMDb+title+year identity binding and runtime verification before streams are exposed.
scrapers.author: YFlix Local
